// cache.ts
export function release(cache, key) { cache.delete(key); }
input.context: let cache; beforeEach(() => { cache = new Map([['a', 1]]); }); afterEach(() => { expect(cache.has('a')).toBe(false); }); No other hooks.
input.contract: Releasing a key must remove the cached entry.

rationale: A teardown assertion observes production state; the test body alone is not the observation boundary.
